decision.label: ANSWER
decision.response: Yes, you can still plant garlic in August. While the ideal planting time for rain-fed agriculture is the beginning of the rainy period (June–July), the manual states that if there is a possibility to supplement with irrigation, garlic can be planted in August.
decision.justification: Section 3.6 'Planting time' on page 11 explicitly states: 'In rain fed agriculture the beginning of the rainy period (June-July) is the favourable period and if there is possibility to supplement by irrigation it can be planted in August.'
